result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but a few visual issues stand out: a loading spinner is stuck on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, the 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name is truncated at the right edge of the horizontal carousel, and the category filter row is cut off at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, suggesting the image failed to finish loading or the spinner is stuck, which obscures the food photo and looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads fully and remove the spinner once loaded; add a proper placeholder/skeleton state and an error fallback if the image fails to load.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped at the right screen edge, truncating the restaurant name and card content.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding or a peek/scroll indicator so partially visible cards clearly signal horizontal scrollability, and ensure text truncation uses an ellipsis gracefully.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, without an obvious scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Provide a visual scroll affordance (fade gradient or chevron) and ensure the row is horizontally scrollable with proper edge padding.
